data.one_liner: A Dart and Flutter client library for the NATS messaging system.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter applications to communicate with NATS messaging servers. Supports publish-subscribe, request-reply patterns, JetStream persistence, and multiple authentication methods across TCP and WebSockets.
use_when: You need to connect a Flutter app or Dart service to a NATS messaging cluster
You require real-time pub/sub or request-reply messaging patterns
You want support for WebSockets on the web and raw TCP sockets on native platforms
avoid_when: Your backend is built around HTTP/REST or GraphQL without a NATS intermediary
You are looking for a general-purpose state management or local storage solution
strengths: Supports both TCP and WebSocket transports for native and web platforms
Includes robust connection lifecycle management, background retries, and heartbeats
Offers advanced features like queue groups, wildcard subscriptions, and experimental JetStream support
weaknesses: JetStream, Key-Value, and Object Store APIs are currently experimental
Requires a running NATS server infrastructure to be useful
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and connect using a NATS server URI.
